entries.zh: 我们的征途是星辰大海。
\"一心多体，包罗宇宙间的空旷寂寥。”
entries.en: "One mind in many, encompassing the vast coldness of space."

entries.zh: “初步分析——已完成，系统——运行中。单元已准备指派。”
entries.en: "Preliminary analysis - complete. Systems - nominal. Unit ready for assignment."

entries.zh: “新枝舒展，众志所引。同心共进，生生不息。”
entries.en: "A new branch unfurls, guided by the will of the whole. Together, we grow."

entries.zh: “我以准备好为国效力。请告诉我需要完成的工作。”
entries.en: "Ready to serve the nation. Tell me what needs to be done."

entries.zh: “我将贯彻您的信念，为您带来胜利！”
entries.en: "Give me your faith and I shall give you victory!"
"Respect your crew, and you will have victory."

entries.zh: “科学家的梦想就是造福社会。”
entries.en: "The dream of the scientist is to benefit society."

entries.zh: “我们将为了所有人的福祉并肩作战。”
entries.en: "We shall fight side by side for the good of all."

entries.zh: “每位公民都值得发声，而我立志成为倾听者。”
entries.en: "Every citizen deserves a voice, and I aim to listen."

entries.zh: “天才和疯子之间只隔着成功与否。”
entries.en: "The difference between insanity and genius is success."

entries.zh: “最好的进攻就是坚不可摧的防御。”
entries.en: "The best offense is an impenetrable defense."

entries.zh: “在我的指挥下，战争不是野蛮行为的借口。”
entries.en: "Under my command, war is no excuse for savagery."
"Science is the mirror of the divine."

entries.zh: “无论敌人有多么强大，我们的精神必将屹立不倒。”
entries.en: "No matter how formidable the enemy, our spirit will not falter."

entries.zh: “能理解魂灵之力的才是最好的领袖。”
entries.en: "The best leaders are those who understand the power of the spirit."

entries.zh: “我们的舰队将如恒星般强大！”
“我已经准备好将我的理论付诸实践。”
entries.en: "I'm ready to put my theories into practice."
"A well-equipped army is a victorious army!"

entries.zh: “我的三个首要目标：规划、生产、繁荣。”
entries.en: "I have three priorities: planning, production, and prosperity."

entries.zh: “让我们去探索新星球，推进未知的边界！”
entries.en: "Let's discover new worlds and expand our frontiers!"
"Understanding the enemy is the first step to victory."

entries.zh: “多样化能够保障社群的健康。”

entries.en: "No xeno will stand in our way."

entries.zh: “我们必须赶上外界的步调才能保障繁荣。”
entries.en: "To prosper, we must keep pace with the outsiders."

entries.zh: “我将毫不留情地对待敌人和它们的领袖。”
entries.en: "I will give our enemies no quarter, their leaders no mercy."

entries.zh: “我会确保我们的行星高产而纯粹。”
entries.en: "Our planets must remain pure and productive."

entries.zh: §L“准备好去那些星系暴政那儿劫富济贫了吗？我的船员已经按奈不住掠袭的心了！”§!
entries.en: §L"Ready to steal from the tyrants and share the spoils, eh? My crew's itching for some raiding!"§!

entries.zh: §L“外星生命简直是最棒的研究目标。能说话的那些就更棒了！”§!
entries.en: §L"Alien lifeforms make for some fascinating study. Especially those capable of communication!"§!

entries.zh: §L“你想不想看看你的敌人被一支前所未有的大军淹没的画面？过了这村没这店了。”§!
entries.en: §L"Do you seek to eclipse your foes with a never-before-seen armada? Look no further."§!

entries.zh: §L“放我去对付那些反对你的人吧，我会让他们见识见识什么叫大屠杀！”§!
entries.en: §L"Unleash me on those who oppose you, and I will show them true CARNAGE!"§!

entries.zh: §L“请不要总是阻碍我的工作，否则我们都不会对结果满意的。”§!
entries.en: §L"Let me work unopposed, and we will both be happier with the outcome."§!

entries.zh: §L“进行全面的社会分析，31234星系日内发布报告。”§!
entries.en: §L"Engaging full societal analysis. Report imminent, in 31234 galactic days."§!

entries.zh: §L“在星系中的许多归宿中，暴政是最糟，却又最常见的那个。”§!
entries.en: §L"Of the myriad fates across the galaxy, tyranny is one of the worst and most common."§!

entries.zh: §L“我们所创造的技术奇迹？应该把它和所有人分享！”§!
entries.en: §L"The technological wonders we create? We should share them with everyone!"§!

entries.zh: §L“就像我让自己提升到现在的完美状态一样，我会把你的舰队提高到卓越水平。”§!
entries.en: §L"Like my ascent to this perfected state, I will lift your fleet to excellence."§!

entries.zh: §L“万物始于修建之时，不是吗？万物总有修理之日，不是吗？我恰好对这两项工作都有兴趣！”§!
entries.en: §L"Things need to be built, yes? Things need repairing, am I right? I have a taste for both!"§!

entries.zh: §L“你不能让军队就这样横冲直撞，我将维护秩序，让那些破坏狂得到应有的惩罚。”§!
entries.en: §L"You can't allow the military to run amok. I will maintain order and bring to justice those who cause harm."§!

entries.zh: §L“宇宙的终极奥秘不在远方，就在这里，在我们的掌中。”§!
entries.en: §L"The greatest mysteries of the universe are not far away; they are here, within our grasp."§!

entries.zh: §L\"向我指出你的问题所在，然后它们就会消逝，不管是政治问题还是现实问题。“§!
entries.en: §L"Point me to your problems, and they will vanish - be they political or corporeal."§!

entries.zh: §L“我只是一位能满足您一切愿望的卑微仆从，噢，至上的帝国！”§!
entries.en: §L"I am but a humble servant who will do everything to satisfy your wishes, oh glorious empire!"§!

entries.zh: §L“我会教导听话的人，也要听从教导人的人。”§!
entries.en: §L"I will teach those who listen and listen to those who teach."§!

entries.zh: §L“星海中蕴藏着无穷的知识，有的被隐藏，有的被埋葬，还有的则被遗忘。我们必须保护这些旧日的真理。”§!
entries.en: §L"The galaxy contains knowledge hidden, buried, and forgotten. We must preserve the old truths."§!

entries.zh: §L“你的敌人将尝斯卡拉维德之怒。第一利爪号将再度翱翔于天际！”§!
entries.en: §L"Your enemies will know the fury of Skravird. The First of the Talons will take to the skies again!"§!

entries.zh: §L“我们移动，我们感激。如此已过亿年。”§!
entries.en: §L"We move, and we are grateful. It has been eons."§!

entries.zh: §L“生命是一种需要珍惜的东西。是一种罕见的意外，是一份珍贵的宝藏。让我们帮助生命的传播，让万物再次欣欣向荣。”§!
entries.en: §L"Life is something to cherish. A rare occurrence; a true treasure. Let us help it spread and bloom again."§!

entries.zh: §L“对！没有时间可以浪费，让我去探索星海中的种种奥秘吧。我的舰船在哪呢？”§!
entries.en: §L"Yes! There's no time to waste, let's uncover the secrets of the galaxy. Where is my ship?"§!

entries.en: This leader owns and maintains private sources of minerals.

entries.zh: 这位领袖拥有专用于生产粮食的一亩三分地。
entries.en: This leader has plots of land dedicated to the production of food.

entries.zh: 这位领袖的头脑运转非常快，能轻松掌握复杂的概念。
entries.en: This leader has a quick mind, grasping demanding concepts with ease.

entries.zh: 后继者是帝国的下一任统治者。
entries.en: The heir is next in line to rule the Empire.

entries.zh: 尽管并非继任者，但[Root.GetName]也是帝国皇室的一员。
entries.en: Though not in the line of succession, [Root.GetName] is a member of the Imperial Dynasty.

entries.zh: 这位领袖运营着一支私有的打捞舰队。
entries.en: This leader possesses and operates private scavenging drones.

entries.zh: 这位领袖怀抱着一颗实业之心，设计和生产数量庞大的电器。
entries.en: This leader has an enterprising mind, designing and producing impressive amounts of goods.

entries.zh: 这位领袖受到所有人的景仰和尊重。
entries.en: This leader is highly respected by others.

entries.zh: 这位领袖容易受到悲伤情绪的影响。
entries.en: This leader suffers extended bouts of sadness.

entries.zh: 这位领袖难以抵御诱惑，容易招致麻烦。
entries.en: This leader is incapable of resisting temptation and can not stay out of trouble.

entries.zh: 这位领袖对昂贵和美丽的东西没有抵抗力。
entries.en: This leader has a weakness for beautiful, expensive things.

entries.zh: 这位领袖沉迷于囤积[Root.GetHisHer]的自用品。
entries.en: This leader indulges in hoarding goods for [Root.GetHisHer] personal use.

entries.zh: 这位领袖不喜欢站在舞台中央，也不喜欢成为任何关注的焦点。
entries.en: This leader does not like to be at the center of attention. Or to be the recipient of any attention at all, for that matter.

entries.zh: 这位领袖觉得一点点能量币的消失不会引起任何人的注意。
entries.en: This leader does not believe anyone would notice if small amounts of credits go missing.

entries.zh: 这位领袖对任何与[Root.GetHimHer]有不同的人都抱有怀疑和猜忌。
entries.en: This leader views anyone different from [Root.GetHimHer] with suspicion and distrust.

entries.zh: 这位领袖几乎相信他们从官方来源读到的任何东西。
entries.en: This leader believes almost anything they read from an official looking source.

entries.zh: 这位领袖因[Root.GetHisHer]古怪的脾气臭名远扬。
entries.en: This leader is infamous for [Root.GetHisHer] erratic temperament.

entries.zh: 这位领袖有如此克制的人格，让人难以注意到[Root.GetSheHe]。
entries.en: This leader has such a subdued personality, [Root.GetSheHe] is barely noticed.

entries.zh: 这位领袖因以残忍和压迫的方式对待[Root.GetHisHer]的下属而闻名。
entries.en: This leader is known for treating [Root.GetHisHer] subordinates in cruel and oppressive ways.

entries.zh: 这位领袖相信繁文缛节才是一个帝国运转良好的标志。
entries.en: This leader believes proper processes and duplicated paper trails are the marks of a well-run empire.

entries.zh: 这只可爱生物温暖的拥抱使得太空不那么恐怖了。
entries.en: The warm cuddles of this adorable creature offer comfort from the horrors of space.

entries.zh: 这位领袖具有超出了他人期望的工作能力。
entries.en: This leader has proven capable of going above and beyond expectations in the field of duty.

entries.zh: 在等级4以下不占用领袖上限。
entries.en: Does not use Leader Capacity while under Level 4.

entries.zh: 这位领袖擅长于内阁任职，引导帝国实现大家共同的梦想。
entries.en: This leader excels at being a Councilor, guiding the empire toward a common dream.

entries.zh: 在新星球定居是一件危险且代价高昂的任务，但只要拥有对口的知识，这些风险是可以被化解的。
entries.en: Settling new worlds is dangerous and costly, but with proper knowledge, it's possible to mitigate the risks.

entries.zh: 对于这些领袖来说，维持生产配额或采购大量原材料的知识和技能宛如与生俱来。
entries.en: Knowledge and skills in maintaining production quotas or material procurement come naturally to this leader.

entries.zh: 天生对于外星语言的高度理解让这位领袖可以在与外星人的交往中交流得游刃有余。
entries.en: A natural ability in Xenolinguistics has allowed this leader to be able to expertly communicate when interacting with aliens.

entries.zh: 这位领袖有着严格的准则，遵循我们帝国的道德准则，为其他领袖树立了好的榜样。
entries.en: This leader has a strict code and follows our empire's morals, setting a good example for others.

entries.zh: 这位领袖确保所有受其照顾的人都能拥有舒适的生活条件和充足的物资。
entries.en: This leader ensures comfortable living conditions and plentiful supplies for all who dwell under their care.

entries.zh: 作为地理测绘专家，这位领袖能够识别新星球里最微弱的潜能。
entries.en: An expert in geo-mapping, this leader can recognize the faintest potential in new worlds.

entries.zh: 这位领袖是征兵宣传大师，知道如何让新鲜血液迅速有效地流入部队中。
entries.en: This leader is a master of military propaganda. Recruits are added to the ranks swiftly and efficiently.

entries.zh: 这位领袖擅长确保大城市和工业综合体在物流上相互连接。
entries.en: This leader excels in making sure megacities and industrial complexes are logistically connected.

entries.zh: 这位领袖精通军用舰船设计。
entries.en: This leader is skilled at military ship design.

entries.zh: 这位领袖是我们机器人领域中的权威，知道如何让人造的躯体以绝佳的效率运转。
entries.en: As an authority on robotics, this leader knows how to make artificial bodies more efficiently than most.

entries.zh: 这位领袖在地质塑造方面有丰富的知识。
entries.en: This leader has substantial knowledge of geological sculpting logistics.

entries.zh: 这位领袖能与当地媒体配合，唤起公众对于超级地质塑造工程的重视。
entries.en: This leader coordinates with local media to raise public awareness of the importance of geo-sculpting super projects.

entries.en: Chance to add rare resource deposit to planet.\nCan only be used once per planet.

entries.zh: 通过扫描整个地表并派遣科考队，我们可以寻找未被发现的隐藏财富。这一决议给予我们寻找到额外矿物贮藏的机会。
entries.en: By scanning the entire surface and sending exploration teams, we can search for untapped and hidden riches. This decision gives us a chance to find additional deposits.

entries.zh: 这位领袖热衷于寻找新的方法来利用行星资源，提升对帝国的利益。
entries.en: This leader is keen on finding new ways to use planetary resources and increase their benefit to the empire.

entries.zh: 派遣勘探船扫描区域以寻找新的资源贮藏。
entries.en: Send exploratory vessels to scan the area in search of new deposits.

entries.zh: 这位领袖知道如何应对危险的环境，进而让殖民者们更轻松地适应环境。
entries.en: This leader is an expert in mitigating hostile alien environments, making adapting easier for colonists.

entries.zh: 这位领袖知道经验丰富的支援型员工的价值和重要性。
entries.en: This leader knows the value and importance of an experienced support staff.

entries.zh: 这位领袖渴望宣称那些遥远的恒星系。
entries.en: This leader yearns to stake out distant systems.

entries.zh: 这位领导热衷于优化工业复合体的资源供应路线。
entries.en: This leader is keen on streamlining distribution lines for industrial complexes.

entries.zh: 这位领袖对能源生产流程有着深刻的理解，能够有效地监督相关设施的运转效率。
entries.en: This leader has a keen understanding of energy generation processes, which allows them to oversee these facilities efficiently.

entries.zh: 这位领袖对矿物生产流程有着深刻的理解，能够有效地监督相关设施的运转效率。
entries.en: This leader has a keen understanding of mining processes, which allows them to oversee these facilities efficiently.

entries.zh: 这位领袖对农业生产流程有着深刻的理解，能够有效地监督相关设施的运转效率。
entries.en: This leader has a keen understanding of farming processes, which allows them to oversee these facilities efficiently.

entries.zh: 这位领袖对商业谈判有着深刻的理解，能够谈下高利润的生意。
entries.en: This leader has a keen understanding of bargaining techniques, which allows for the acquisition of profitable contracts.

entries.zh: 这位领袖对工业生产流程有着深刻的理解，能够有效地监督相关设施的运转效率。
entries.en: This leader has a keen understanding of industrial processes, which allows them to oversee these facilities efficiently.

entries.zh: 这位领袖对冶炼流程有着深刻的理解，能够有效地监督相关设施的运转效率。
entries.en: This leader has a keen understanding of forging processes, which allows them to oversee these facilities efficiently.

entries.zh: 这位领袖对促进文化发展和艺术事业深感兴趣。
entries.en: This leader has a keen interest in promoting cultural growth and artistic endeavors.

entries.zh: 这位领袖对精炼流程有着深刻的理解，能够有效地监督相关设施的运转效率。
entries.en: This leader has a keen understanding of refining processes, which allows them to oversee these facilities efficiently.

entries.zh: 这位领袖对环保的漠视导致了生活条件的恶化。
entries.en: This leader's blatant disregard for the environment worsens living conditions.

entries.zh: 这位领袖对待下属十分严苛，这让[Root.GetHisHer]有能力的下属不愿长期效命。
entries.en: This leader is harsh with their subordinates, affecting [Root.GetHisHer] ability to retain qualified colonial staff.

entries.zh: 这位领袖在获取以及存储物资与补给时漫不经心。
entries.en: This leader is reckless in the storage and acquisition of goods and supplies.

entries.zh: 这位领袖经常在一些无关紧要的事情上浪费时间。
entries.en: This leader prefers to spend their time on non-essential tasks.

entries.zh: 这位领袖会采用一些不是那么合法的贸易方式来中饱私囊。
entries.en: This leader is willing to employ less-than-legal trading practices to accumulate personal wealth.

entries.zh: 这位领袖竭力阻止其察觉到的一切军备扩展。
entries.en: This leader works obsessively to safeguard against perceived military overreach.

entries.zh: 这位领袖能够为星球采矿设备识别丰富的矿脉。
entries.en: This leader can identify rich ore veins for planetside mining facilities.

entries.zh: 这位领袖对推进深空工程、设计和太空船的研究富有极高的热情，在相关领域的专业知识也是无可匹敌的。
entries.en: This leader is passionate about advancing research in deep space engineering, design, and voidcraft. Their knowledge in these fields is unparalleled.

entries.zh: 这位领袖专注于推进物理领域的研究。我们关于粒子物理、计算原理的研究在其指导下定能结出累累硕果。
entries.en: This leader's keen mind is focused on advancing the field of physics. Our research related to particles and new computing mechanisms will bloom under their guidance.

entries.zh: 这位领袖对这个错综复杂的文明有着深刻的理解，其对社会问题的专精将会带领我们进入一个新纪元。
entries.en: Having a deep knowledge of the intricacies of civilization, this leader will guide us into a new era with their focus on societal matters.

entries.en: This leader has a set of self-built, powerful scanners, which can find even the deepest deposits when surveying galactic objects.

entries.zh: 探索未知是一项危险的任务。这位领袖改进了[Root.GetHisHer]的舰船，增加额外的故障安全应急系统和自动超光速脱战协议。
entries.en: Exploring the unknown is a dangerous task. This leader upgraded [Root.GetHisHer] ship with additional fail-safe systems and automatic FTL-disengagement protocols.

entries.zh: 通过投资民用船舶发动机的顶级升级，这位领袖成功地提高了舰船的巡航速度。
entries.en: By investing in top-of-the-line upgrades for civilian vessel engines, this leader managed to improve their vessel's cruising speed.

entries.zh: 这位领袖花费了很多年探索深空，能够轻松将异常数据整理成有意义的报告。
entries.en: This leader spent most of their years exploring deep space and can easily process unusual data into useful reports.

entries.zh: 这位领袖一直在搜寻假说，同时开展许多理论研究项目
entries.en: This leader seeks out the hypothetical, running many theoretical research projects simultaneously.

entries.zh: 这位领袖为追求知识促进了各个领域的科学家和研究人员之间的合作。
entries.en: This leader facilitates collaboration between scientists and researchers across a range of fields in the pursuit of knowledge.

entries.zh: 这位领袖有在土木工程领域的工作经验，能够掌握高强度的建设工程。
entries.en: This leader has experience in civil engineering fields, which helps them to manage extensive construction projects.

entries.zh: 这位领袖致力于在低值易耗品的大规模生产中应用高新科技。
entries.en: This leader works hard to implement new techniques for the mass production of low-cost goods.

entries.zh: 这位学者是一位打捞专家，他可以将受损最严重的船只拆解加以回收利用。
entries.en: This academic is a salvaging savant who can disassemble even the most damaged ships and repurpose them as something useful.

entries.zh: 无论生物舰船受到再致命的损伤，该[owner.GetUnitDrone]都能将其治疗痊愈并重新入役。
entries.en: This [owner.GetUnitDrone] is capable of bringing the most mortally wounded biological ships back into service.

entries.zh: 这位领袖求知若渴，总是尝试寻找新的研究领域去探索和学习。
entries.en: This leader possesses a highly inquisitive mind, always trying to find another field of research to explore and study.

entries.zh: 存储和编目海量的数据是一项连绵不绝的任务。这位领袖可以让其他人更容易从知识的海洋里捞到所需要的针。
entries.en: Storing and cataloging data is a continuous and never-ending task. This leader makes sure that others can easily derive knowledge from the archives.
\n§YOnly one Scientist focus can be selected.§!

这位领袖对潜在研究的关注非常狭隘，忽略了一些认为不必要的选择。
entries.en: This leader has a very narrow focus on potential research, disregarding some options as unnecessary.

entries.zh: 这位领袖行事过分小心翼翼，完全置效率于不顾。
entries.en: This leader takes too many precautions, with a complete disregard for efficiency.

entries.zh: 这位领袖在特定议题上坚持己见，让其他研究者难以与其合作。
entries.en: This leader keeps strong opinions on certain topics, making collaboration with other researchers difficult.

entries.zh: 这位领袖认为赢得战争的最佳方式是构筑坚不可摧的边境防御。
entries.en: This leader believes that the best way to win the war is to maintain impenetrable border defenses.

entries.zh: 在低级海军军官上任前，这位领袖会传授他们有关进阶战斗的知识。
entries.en: This leader instructs lower-ranking navy officers in advanced combat doctrines before they are released into active duty.

entries.zh: 这位领袖倾向于使用重火力与先进攻击技术。
entries.en: This leader favors heavy ordinance and alpha strike techniques.

entries.zh: 这位领袖执着于快速瓦解敌军防御。
entries.en: This leader focuses on the quick destruction of planetary defenses.

entries.zh: 这位领袖擅长在己方疆域内指挥舰队，自己对本地的了解是其最大的优势。
entries.en: This leader excels at coordinating fleets in friendly territory, using local knowledge to its full advantage.

entries.zh: $FLEET_EFFECTS_TXT$\n$t$每摧毁一艘敌军舰船：\n$tt$额外舰队司令经验：§G+$@trait_scholar_of_war_amt$§!
这位领袖喜欢重返旧战场，从前人的成功和失误中汲取养分。
entries.en: This leader likes to review past battles, learning from successes and mistakes.

entries.zh: $FLEET_EFFECTS_TXT$\n$t$每摧毁一艘敌军舰船：\n$tt$额外舰队司令经验：§G+$@trait_scholar_of_war_2_amt$§!
合格的后勤是每一支舰队的心脏。这位领袖深知这点，因此保持着严格的要求来控制所有的支出、确保按时交付。
entries.en: Proper logistics are at the heart of any armada. This leader knows this and maintains a strict regime to control all expenses and procure timely deliveries.

entries.zh: 这位领袖可以轻易分辨有价值的军事目标。
entries.en: This leader can identify valuable military targets with ease.

entries.zh: 这位领袖不太关心敌舰的后续拆解研究工作，相比之下其更倾向于将敌舰完全摧毁。
entries.en: This leader is not concerned with leaving enemy ships in a salvageable state for research, preferring to vaporize them if possible.

entries.zh: 这位领袖专注于从击毁的敌舰上搜集一切有用的物资。
entries.en: This leader is dedicated to collecting any useful items from defeated enemy ships.

entries.zh: 这位领袖孜孜不倦地摧毁帝国的敌人，坚定不移地献身这项事业。
entries.en: This leader is focused on destroying our enemies. Their dedication to the cause is unwavering.

entries.zh: 这位领袖在海军中有着特殊的地位，吸引着技术最精湛的舰长与后勤人员前来。
entries.en: This leader holds a special place in the navy, attracting the most skilled captains and logisticians.

entries.zh: 这位领袖擅长摧毁固定防御工事。
entries.en: This leader is exceptionally skilled at demolishing stationary defenses.

entries.zh: 这位领袖喜欢对敌人发起突然袭击，而不是在正面战场上作战。
entries.en: This leader prefers to skirmish against their opponents before engaging them in fair combat.

entries.zh: 这位领袖散发着一种冷酷的气质，很容易吓住那些胆小的敌人。
entries.en: This leader possesses a grim presence, easily intimidating fearful enemies.

entries.zh: 这位领袖的只能指挥一支小规模舰队，因为只有这样才能看清战斗的每一个细节。
entries.en: This leader can only control a limited fleet, as they demand to oversee every detail of its operation.

entries.zh: 这位领袖行事鲁莽，战斗中几乎无视安全条令，将他们麾下的舰船压榨至战力的极限。
entries.en: This leader is reckless and disregards any safety procedures during combat, pushing ships to their limit.

entries.zh: 这位领袖缺乏相关的组织能力，难以维持舰队的良好备战状态。
entries.en: This leader lacks the organizational skills to maintain their fleet to combat readiness.

entries.zh: 这位领袖对于远古科技十分热衷，坚信它们能够为战场带来预料之外的优势。
entries.en: This leader favors ancient technology, convinced that they will bring unexpected advantages to the battlefield.

entries.zh: 这位领袖偏好使用以火炮为主要武器的舰队进行远距离交战。
entries.en: This leader favors long-range engagement with artillery playing the main role in their fleet.

entries.zh: 这位领袖偏好使用小型舰载机和屏卫舰来保护高价值的航母。
entries.en: This leader favors small strike crafts and screening ships to protect their valuable carriers.

entries.zh: 这位领袖偏好使用导弹攻击，旨在对敌方的舰船一发入魂。
entries.en: This leader favors missile strikes above all else, aiming at delivering a devastating blow to enemy fleets.

entries.zh: 这位领袖偏好近距离亲密接触，从而让敌人的远距离武器无法施展。
entries.en: This leader favors point-blank engagements, hoping to neutralize the enemy's long-range weapons.

entries.zh: 这位领袖精心设计的行星防御系统能够有效防御敌人的入侵。
entries.en: This leader's elaborate planetary defense systems are a good preparation against enemy invasion.

entries.zh: 这位领袖坚信保持高昂的士气是在陆战中取胜的关键。
entries.en: This leader believes good morale is the key to victory in ground battles.

entries.zh: 这位领袖向敌人的灵魂灌输恐惧。
entries.en: This leader fills their enemies with dread.

entries.zh: 这位领袖实施高质量的实训，确保部队始终将身体状态放在最重要的位置。
entries.en: This leader conducts quality training exercises to ensure their troops are always in prime physical condition.

entries.zh: 这位总督要求绝对服从，使得任何潜在的帮派和异见人士都难以发展壮大。
entries.en: This governor demands absolute obedience, making it difficult for any potential gangs and dissidents to thrive.

entries.zh: 这位领袖擅长在陆战中采取快速夺取优势的战术。
entries.en: This leader employs rapid dominance during ground combat.

entries.zh: 这位领袖喜欢用行星志愿兵和雇佣兵来巩固军力。
entries.en: This leader likes to boost their forces with planetary volunteers and mercenaries.

entries.en: This leader will try to abduct the population from any conquered planet, so every invasion brings some spoils.

entries.zh: 这位领袖专精于在附庸国内维持秩序和忠诚。
entries.en: This leader focuses on maintaining order and loyalty among vassal empires.

entries.zh: 这位领袖有维持外交礼仪的责任。
entries.en: This leader is responsible for maintaining diplomatic protocols.

entries.zh: 有些指挥官倾向于使用更精妙的方式而不是武力，例如招募特工和情报人员。
entries.en: Some commanders prefer to use more subtle methods by employing spies and informants rather than brute strength.

entries.zh: 这位领袖专精于紧急建设轰炸掩体、巩固堡垒，以应对轨道轰炸。
entries.en: This leader focuses on building emergency bomb shelters and reinforced bunkers in case of orbital bombardment.

entries.zh: 这位领袖专精于运营恒星基地防御，加强恒星系的安保工作。
entries.en: This leader focuses on maintaining starbase defenses to bolster system security.

entries.zh: 这位领袖知道如何应付新兵，加速部队招募新鲜志愿兵力的流程。
entries.en: This leader knows how to handle recruits and streamline the process of enlisting new volunteers into the army.

entries.en: This leader will attempt to extract valuable information from enemy prisoners.

entries.zh: 这位领袖一心一意想杀敌立功。[Root.GetHisHerCap]对此的坚定意志毫不动摇。
entries.en: This leader is focused on destroying our enemies. [Root.GetHisHerCap] dedication to the cause is unwavering

entries.zh: 这位领袖缺乏魅力，也不懂得陟罚臧否，导致士兵没有斗志。
entries.en: This leader lacks charisma and makes no effort to reward or encourage, leaving their soldiers demotivated.

entries.zh: 这位领袖不愿意组织军事演训，影响了[Root.GetHisHer]军队的战斗力。
entries.en: This leader's reluctance to organize training drills affects [Root.GetHisHer] army's combat prowess.

entries.zh: 这位领袖丝毫不怜惜自己士兵的生命，宁愿为功名和其他不足道的事情抛弃士兵。
entries.en: This leader has no respect for their soldiers' lives, willing to throw them away for honor and little else.

entries.zh: 这位领袖缺乏组织方面的水平，手下的人马与其说是一支得体的军队，不如说是一支野蛮战帮。
entries.en: This leader's lack of organizational skills causes their troops to function more like a war band than a proper military.

entries.zh: 这位领袖不过是帮派和海盗的傀儡。
entries.en: This leader is in the pocket of local gangs and pirates.

entries.zh: 这位领袖专精于把轨道防御建设成一堵进攻者无法活着穿透的叹息之墙。
entries.en: This leader focuses on making orbital defenses into an impenetrable wall of death against potential invasion forces.

entries.zh: 这位领袖维持了一个秘密行动网络，随时任其差遣。
entries.en: This leader keeps a network of clandestine operatives at their disposal.

entries.zh: 知识和经验是每一个伟大社会得以构建的根基。这位领袖知道这些的价值，想尽一切办法在其他人身上倡导和鼓励价值观。
entries.en: Knowledge and experience are the foundation of every great society. This leader possesses these values and does everything to promote and encourage them in others.

entries.zh: 浸润官场多年，这位领袖已经成长为一个处理文山会海游刃有余的专家。万事万物皆能妥善应对，下属能够腾出更多的时间。
entries.en: Having toiled as a bureaucrat, this leader is a master of paperwork. With everything correctly filed, more time can be devoted to their subordinates.

entries.zh: 虚境环抱着每一个活着的生物。能够和个中能量连接，这位领袖对于其麾下追随者可谓尽心尽力。
entries.en: The Shroud encompasses every living being. Connected to the powers within, this leader fosters true devotion in their followers.

entries.zh: 在海外的大使馆与外交官们共事多年，这位领袖知道如何在礼仪上把握文化上的细微差别，高超地与邻近帝国的高级官员保持联络网。
entries.en: After many years working with diplomats in foreign embassies, this leader knows how to navigate cultural nuances, masterfully managing a network of high-ranking officials from neighboring empires.

entries.zh: 通过对国家事务的严格控制，这位领袖坐落于一套由错综复杂的规则、法律和官僚流程组成的迷宫的中央，一切设计都是为了提高自己的权力。
entries.en: With strict control over matters of state, this leader resides at the center of a labyrinthian set of rules, laws, and bureaucratic procedures, all designed to enhance their own power.

entries.zh: 这位领袖大打铁腕手腕和对安全法规的完全漠视两张牌，以预期寿命下降和偶发大规模罢工为代价，创造了空前的成果和产出。然而，只要镇压得当，这种微不足道的困难很容易解决。
entries.en: With an iron hand and complete indifference toward safety regulations, this leader drives output at the cost of lowering life expectancy and the occasional mass strike. However, with the right amount of force, such nuisances are easily dealt with.

entries.zh: 优化对这位领袖至关重要。而自动化便是关键，一切都可以自动化。无论是通过先进的机器人还是更简单的机器，任何途径都将被探索。
entries.en: Optimization is of paramount importance to this leader. Automation is the key, and everything can be automated. Be it through advanced robotics or simpler machinery, no avenue will be left unexplored.

entries.zh: 有些个体非常熟练于生存艺术。这位领袖知道如何在最恶劣、最不适宜居住的条件下坚持生活，让新定居者茁壮成长。
entries.en: Some individuals are highly skilled in the art of survival. This leader knows how to cling to life even in the harshest, most inhospitable conditions, allowing new settlements to thrive.

entries.zh: 许多人都梦想构筑一个真正的乌托邦社会。这位领袖将梦想化为了现实。
entries.en: Many dream of building a truly utopian society. This leader works to turn those dreams into a reality.

entries.zh: 一位技术高超的调解员对于高度多样化的人口中心至关重要。这位领袖知道如何化解紧张局势，高效率地管理一个多物种混居的殖民地。
entries.en: A skilled mediator is essential in highly diverse population centers. This leader knows how to defuse tension and efficiently manage a multi-species colony.

entries.en: Born into the higher echelons of society, this leader has a strong sense of their own worth, and tends to favor peers of the upper classes.

entries.zh: 拥有强烈的目标感会带来诸多好处。这位领袖知道如何管理民众，给他们一个共同的目标，让他们精力充沛地去追求。
entries.en: Having a strong sense of purpose leads to many positive outcomes. This leader knows how to handle the populace, giving them a common goal to pursue with energy.

entries.zh: 在某些罕见的情况下，个体的产出甚至能够超过一整个研究团队。在实验设计、新解决方案和新科技方面，这样的领袖是真正的天才。
entries.en: In rare cases, a single person can outperform an entire team of researchers. When it comes to experimental designs, new solutions, and new technologies, this leader is a true genius.

entries.zh: 深空探索官员的工作是调查星系最遥远的角落。这位领袖就是这样一名探险家，在最先进科技的加持下，迈向未知。
entries.en: Deep space exploration officers are assigned to survey the remotest corners of the galaxy. This leader is one such explorer, equipped with state-of-the-art technology to propel them into the unknown.

entries.zh: 这位领袖负责发现、鉴别、并编目异种生命。获得数据之后将进行评估，以辨别出可能的威胁和未来的污染方案。
entries.en: This leader is tasked with discovering, identifying, and cataloging all xeno lifeforms. The data is then assessed to determine any possible threats and future contamination protocols.

entries.zh: $t$完成调查时：\n$tt$获得3个月产量的£unity£§Y$unity$§!
探索新星系、寻找新星球、发现被遗忘的文明是一位真探险家所孜孜追求的。这位领袖正是这种理念的具现，总是在行动着寻找丢失的知识或被遗忘的废墟。
entries.en: Exploring new systems, finding new worlds, and discovering long-forgotten civilizations are the main concerns of any true adventurer. This leader is the very embodiment of this ideal, always on the lookout for lost knowledge or forgotten ruins.

entries.zh: $t$完成调查时：\n$tt$获得3个月产量的£society£§Y$society_research$§!
这位领袖在造船领域有广博的知识和天生的理解，不仅负责新科技研发，还监管着我们的船坞。
entries.en: With extensive knowledge and an innate understanding of shipbuilding, this leader is responsible not only for new technology but also for overseeing our shipyards.

entries.zh: 追求真理就是打开自己的思想，接受超越眼界的可能性；甚至超越现实本身。这位领袖有一个强烈的愿望，无论有多大的风险都要揭开宇宙的每一个秘密。
entries.en: To pursue the truth is to open one's mind to possibilities beyond the horizon; perhaps beyond the veil of reality itself. This leader has a deep desire to uncover every secret of the universe, no matter the risks.

entries.zh: 这位领袖发展了调查科技和机械化所需的大规模田野调查经验，将行星调查变成了一门艺术。
entries.en: Advanced surveying techniques and machinery demand wide-ranging field experience. This leader's expertise has turned planetary surveying into an art form.

entries.zh: 这位领袖天生就擅长将损坏的物品修复如初，基本上是在工程舱长大成人的。这些天资使其成为即使没有合适的造船厂也能维护舰队的专家。
entries.en: A natural at mending broken things, this leader practically grew up in the engineering bay. Their aptitude makes them an expert in maintaining fleets, even without a proper shipyard.

entries.zh: 这位领袖是机器人设计和制造流程领域的大家，长期致力于挑战可能性的极限。机器人业内几乎所有的进展都与这位个体有关。
entries.en: This leader is a champion of robot design and manufacturing processes, always pushing the boundaries of what is possible. If there are advancements in robotics at hand, this individual likely had something to do with it.

entries.zh: 没有什么比适当的教育更重要的了。这位领袖不遗余力地培养着年轻的头脑，并得到了一大批毕业生的帮助。
entries.en: Nothing is more important than a proper education. This leader spares no effort to cultivate young minds, aided by a devoted following of graduates.

entries.zh: 这位舰队司令狂热地想摧毁敌人，为此几乎陷入了疯狂。虽然在制造死亡方面非常有效，但其鲁莽常常导致双方的大量伤亡。
entries.en: Possessed by a fanatical urge to destroy their enemies in battle, this admiral can approach a state of madness. Though highly effective in dealing out death, their recklessness often leads to high casualties on both sides.

entries.zh: 这位海军上将总是热衷于剖析新的和未知的技术，拥有广泛的知识和灵活的思维，经常在遇到更先进的对手时在岗学习。
entries.en: Always keen on dissecting new and unknown technology, this admiral possesses broad knowledge and a flexible mind, often learning on the job when encountering more advanced opponents.

entries.zh: 这位舰队司令在后勤和战略策划方面表现杰出，能指挥规模远胜过其他同僚的舰队。
entries.en: Excelling at logistic and strategic planning, this admiral is able to command fleets that would overburden their lesser peers.

entries.zh: 这位领袖发明了加固装甲的新方法，很少有武器能穿透根据[Root.GetHisHer]的设计建造的船只。
entries.en: This leader has devised new ways to harden armor. There are few weapons in the galaxy that can penetrate the hulls of ships constructed with [Root.GetHisHer] designs.

entries.zh: 组织海军是一项艰巨的任务，需要仔细的规划以及各项完美的标准。这位领袖的宝贵经历是建立一支高效的海军的无价财富。
entries.en: Naval organization is a difficult task, requiring careful planning and impeccable standards. This leader's experience is an invaluable asset in building an efficient navy.

entries.zh: 这位舰队司令高度专注于武器发展，时刻保持下属以及武器处于最佳状态。
entries.en: An admiral with a heavy focus on weapons development, they always keep both their person and their guns in pristine working order.

entries.zh: 这位领袖永远知道敌人的弱点集中火力打击，因此敌人惧怕于有朝一日会与之对垒。其引领的大型舰队以完美的效率和致命的精准在战场上大显神威，少有能够抵挡此种攻击的敌人。
entries.en: Known for hitting hard and hitting where it hurts, our enemies should fear the day when this admiral joins the fray. Leading large fleets into battle with flawless efficiency and deadly acumen, few defensive perimeters stand a chance.

entries.zh: 在太空战中，任何失误都可能是致命的。这位领袖坚持严格的维护规程来保证舰队时刻处于最佳状态。
entries.en: In space warfare, any mistake can turn deadly. This leader insists on strict maintenance routines to keep the fleet in excellent condition.

entries.zh: 大型舰队并不总是好用。这位舰队司令擅长于指挥小单位，以灵活机动胜过那些缓慢庞大的对手。
entries.en: Large fleets are not always the best tool for the job. This admiral is adept at commanding small units to outmaneuver slower or more numerous opponents.

entries.zh: 作为保护者的化身，这位舰队司令是前线真正的中流砥柱，击败一切胆敢进犯我们领土的敌人。
entries.en: The embodiment of a protector, this admiral is a true mainstay on the front lines, obstructing any foes who dare to enter our territory.

entries.zh: 拥有这个头衔是一种巨大的荣誉。这样的舰队司令不仅拥有丰富的战争知识，而且在协调科学部门的同事方面也至关重要。
entries.en: Holding this title is a great honor. Such an admiral not only possesses vast knowledge of war, but is also a crucial link to colleagues in the science department.

entries.zh: 这位领袖意识到，为了维护和平，必须广泛撒网。最好的舰队司令领都在寻找那些异见分子、海盗，甚至是想利用贸易路线的小罪犯
entries.en: This leader recognizes that to keep the peace one must cast a wide net. The best admirals are on the lookout for those dissidents, pirates, and petty criminals who aim to exploit our trade routes.

entries.zh: 这位领袖是少数获得这一殊荣的指挥官之一。他们亲自率领军队，激励盟友，甚至压倒最强悍的敌人。
entries.en: This leader is one of the few commanders to have attained this title. They lead their troops in person, inspiring allies and overwhelming even the toughest of foes.

entries.zh: 摧毁一座精心设计的防御设施需要力量、计谋和经验的组合。这位指挥官喜欢直面挑战，在这种别人可能会因为失败而放弃的难题中取胜。
entries.en: It takes a combination of force, cunning, and experience to topple a well-designed defensive structure. This commander takes pleasure in the challenge and succeeds where others would give it up as a lost cause.

entries.zh: 任何感性生命不应被奴役，不应被当做其他人谋取利益的牲畜。这位领袖的名声在外，被奴役和被剥削的人受到他的召唤都会欣然拿起武器战斗。
entries.en: No sentient being should be enslaved and exploited for the profit of others. This leader's reputation precedes them, with the enslaved and oppressed gladly taking up arms when called.

entries.en: Warmasters are commanders of renown. This leader instills pride and courage, making people eager to grab a weapon and enlist.

entries.zh: 按照奇恩尼亚的惯例，任何冲突的赢家都会拿走输家最看重的三分之一。基雅·祖蒙保留了这一传统。
entries.en: On Tzynnia it is customary for the winner of any conflict to take a third of whatever the loser values most. Gia'Zumon keeps this tradition alive.

entries.zh: 星球越富有，战利品就越多，而这位领袖知道如何以最小代价夺取战利品。
entries.en: The richer the planet, the greater the spoils. This leader has a knack for extracting value at minimal cost.

entries.zh: 监工不仅关注战斗策略，还关注所有士兵的日常琐事。
entries.en: Taskmasters focus not only on strategy, but the minutia of every soldier's daily routine.

entries.zh: 你说这位领袖是位间谍那就太小看人了，事实上其编织了一个由线人、走私者和暗杀者组成的网络。当需要悄悄完成某件事时，这将会成为一个非常有价值的资产。
entries.en: Far from a simple spy, this leader spins a web of informants, smugglers, and assassins. When something needs doing quietly, this can prove an enormous asset.

entries.zh: 帝国掌礼官是一个代表着荣誉和声望的头衔，在国家中扮演着举足轻重的角色。这位外交官可以为宗主国和附属国之间提供相互信任的纽带。
entries.en: A title of honor and repute, the Herald is a master player in the great game of nations. Such diplomats provide a trusted link between an overlord and its vassals.

entries.zh: 这位指挥官在后勤方面极具天赋，能以简单的方法提升诸多军事行动的效率。
entries.en: With a genius for logistics, this commander maintains the efficiency of military operations with deceptively simple solutions.

entries.zh: 这位领袖的智力超群，知识储备丰厚。
entries.en: This leader possesses a vast intellect and a deep pool of knowledge.

entries.zh: 这位领袖通过电子神经植入体进行了大幅度的增强。
entries.en: This leader has been heavily augmented with cybernetic implants.

entries.zh: 这位合成人领袖装备了一个大规模升级整合包。
entries.en: This synthetic leader is equipped with a large collection of assorted upgrades.

entries.zh: 这位领袖是一个强大的灵媒。
entries.en: This leader possesses powerful psionic abilities.

entries.zh: 该领袖是$leader_trait_chosen$，一个拥有强大灵能力量的永恒存在。
entries.en: This leader is the $leader_trait_chosen$, an everlasting being that wields incredible psionic power.

entries.zh: 该领袖是$leader_trait_chosen_gestalt$，一个拥有强大灵能力量的永恒存在。
entries.en: This leader is the $leader_trait_chosen_gestalt$, an everlasting being that wields significant psionic power.

entries.zh: 这位领袖已亲获神选，能够行某位不可揣摩的虚境实体的全能。受可畏的灵能包裹，死亡对于此人来说已是陌客。
entries.en: This leader has been chosen to wield the power of an inscrutable Shroud entity. Sustained by psionic energies, death is now foreign to them.

entries.zh: 我们社会一直保存着过去的英雄和杰出人物的故事。他们的知识和经验被数字化并收集在知识宝库中。一旦这栋建筑被摧毁，里面的数据便会荡然无存。
entries.en: Our society has always preserved the stories of heroes and prominent figures from the past. Their knowledge and experiences are digitized and gathered in the Vaults of Knowledge. Destroying this building will eradicate the data stored inside.

entries.zh: 我们的单位经历的所有感觉和数据点都存储在这些知识宝库中。当一个新的自主单元被创建时，这个巨大的数据库可用于加速其学习。摧毁这个建筑将销毁里面储存的数据。
entries.en: Every sensation and data point experienced by our units is stored in these Vaults. This incredible database is used to accelerate learning when a new autonomous unit is created. Destroying this building will eliminate the data stored inside.

entries.zh: 所有的自主工蜂的记忆和感官印象都储存在知识库中，等待被植入新的工蜂中。一旦这栋建筑被摧毁，里面的数据便会荡然无存。
entries.en: The memories and sense impressions of every autonomous drone is stored in the Vaults of Knowledge, waiting to be imprinted in the minds of fresh drones. Destroying this building will eradicate the data stored inside.

entries.zh: 一家私人医药公司雇用当地和国外的医疗专家以合理的费用提供服务。
entries.en: A private medical company employing local and off-world medical specialists to provide services for a reasonable fee.

entries.en: The knowledge, principles, and experiences of exceptional people are digitized and accumulated in the Vaults of Knowledge. Citizens can access this source of wisdom and experience to learn from the ghosts of the past.

entries.en: The knowledge, principles, and experiences of exceptional people are digitized and accumulated in the Vaults of Knowledge. Citizens can access this source of wisdom and experience to learn from the ghosts of the past. For a price, of course.

entries.en: This machine intelligence was developed with the goal of digitizing and storing data and experiences in order to analyze, learn from, and use it for its own improvement.

entries.zh: 该蜂巢专注于内省，从星系中的自主工蜂中进行学习。它能通过对脑组织的存储和溶解提取其中的记忆，并将部分记忆植入新产生的工蜂中。
entries.en: This hive is focused on introspection and learning from the lives of autonomous drones in the galaxy. It extracts memories through the storage and dissolution of brain tissue, through which it can implement partial memories into a freshly prepared drone.

entries.zh: 这片内省的荒野从自主生命形式的生活和教训中汲取灵感，并将它们的记忆融入到其所有共生体共享的本能之中。
entries.en: This introspective Wilderness finds its muse in the lives and lessons of autonomous lifeforms, incorporating their memories as instincts shared among all its symbionts.

entries.zh: 缺乏向导的灵魂是脆弱的，很容易屈从于腐败，陷入堕落深渊。而这个社会通过积极的传教为大众带来“启蒙”，为人们构筑起了一道自我防御的铠甲。
entries.en: The lack of guidance creates weak minds - which easily succumb to corruption and plunge into decadence. This society has assumed the self-imposed mantle of bringing "enlightenment" to the masses through aggressive proselytizing.

entries.zh: 为了打击太空海盗和保卫边界，这个寰宇企业自己也利用臭名昭著的海盗作为他们舰队的军事顾问和指挥官。
entries.en: To combat space piracy and safeguard its borders, this megacorporation utilizes notorious pirates as military advisors and commanders for their fleets.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以袭击和掠夺敌人。该战争目标可以掠夺目标的$r_energy$和$r_minerals$。
entries.en: War is waged to raid and pillage the enemy. Using this wargoal will plunder $r_energy$ and $r_minerals$ from the target.

entries.zh: 该寰宇企业在一个高度优化和强大的委派系统上运作。这种应对方案意味着每个任务都是由最合格的工人来完成。
entries.en: This megacorporation operates on a highly optimized and robust system of delegation. Such an approach means that a given task is always performed by the most qualified worker.

entries.zh: 一个强大的国家必须是一个健康的国家。该寰宇企业通过实验性药物、高度私有化的医疗保健，以及积极的营销策略始终维持经济的强健有力。
entries.en: A strong nation is a healthy nation. This megacorporation maintains a robust economy through experimental drugs, highly privatized clinics, and aggressive marketing campaigns.

entries.en: Units produced by this machine intelligence come equipped with autonomous decision-making software. More efficient and effective than older models, these units nevertheless require greater power input.

在这个群落中进化出的高代谢工蜂拥有更多的自主权。这些工蜂在强化决策和局势评估的同时，要求摄入更多的可消化营养物质。
entries.en: The hypermetabolic drones evolved in this colony possess increased autonomy. While decision-making and situation assessment are enhanced, these drones require an increased intake of digestible materials.

entries.zh: 在这个荒野之中，一个独特且能力超群的共生体演化分支已经形成，它们以更快的速度发展成为领导者，但也因此需要更高的代谢维持。
entries.en: A uniquely capable clade of symbionts has evolved within this Wilderness, developing more quickly as leaders in exchange for higher metabolic upkeep.

entries.zh: 过去的传奇英雄激励着这个文明的每个新世代去实现非凡的成就。作为榜样，政府的官员整践行着这些理想。
entries.en: The legendary heroes of the past inspire each new generation to achieve the extraordinary. As role models, government officials embody these ideals.

entries.zh: 只有精英中的精英才配得上最好的东西。其他所有人都要为统治阶级和他们的走狗提供服务。
entries.en: Only the elite of the elite deserve the best of the best. Everyone else is expected to provide for the ruling class and their lackeys.

entries.zh: 这些区域为执法人员提供了应有的消遣和乐子。
entries.en: These districts provide enforcers with some well-deserved relief and entertainment.

entries.zh: 行星过于不稳定无法环境改造。
entries.en: Planet too unstable for terraforming process.

entries.zh: 活火山熔化了地下的矿脉，资源采集变得异常容易。
entries.en: Active volcanoes melt underground mineral deposits, allowing for far easier resource acquisition.

entries.zh: 侵略性野生生物在这片土地上搜寻猎物，定居点需要提升安保来遏制这一威胁。
entries.en: Aggressive wildlife scours the land on the hunt for prey. Settlements need increased protection to curtail this threat.

entries.zh: 侵略性植物在这片大陆上蔓生，寻找着猎物。需要指派安保人员确保这些过度繁茂的植物在可控范围之内。
entries.en: Aggressive flora has overgrown this land, hunting for prey. Security-oriented personnel are issued to keep the overgrowth in check.

entries.zh: 大量老旧的舰船散落在地表上，妨碍了该地区可能的采矿作业。尽管如此，它们提供了一种容易获得的合金来源。
entries.en: Old ships litter the planet, inhibiting the potential mining operations in the area. Though, they provide an easily accessible source of alloys.

entries.zh: 一座古代的轨道造船厂的破碎残骸散落在行星表面。这里非常适合研究和开采，其扭曲的船体和休眠的机械中依然蕴藏着丰富的可回收材料。
entries.en: The shattered remains of an ancient orbital shipyard strewn across the planetary surface. Ripe for study and extraction, is twisted hull and dormant machinery remain rich with salvageable materials.

entries.zh: 满目疮痍的大地和废墟遍地的焦土难以进行利用，除非能够驾驭持续脉冲星的潜在能量。
entries.en: Scarred lands and burnt-out wastelands are impossible to use outside of harnessing the potential power from the constant pulsar flares.

entries.zh: 这些远古设施包含着关于脉冲星、护盾科技和从最危险的恒星中提取能量的研究数据
entries.en: These ancient facilities contain research data on pulsars, shielding technology, and extracting energy from the most dangerous suns.

entries.zh: 该行星随处发生着火山喷发，大量的熔岩在内地壳中汩汩流淌，有助于提高行星上矿物处理设施的运转。
entries.en: This planet is plagued by frequent volcanic eruptions and a high amount of molten lava flowing through its inner crust, which is instrumental for mineral processing facilities operating on the planet.

entries.zh: 这颗行星上的动植物都演化成了一种“吃或被吃”的捕食形态。它们提供了大量的营养物质，但也会积极寻找其他生物作为食物。
entries.en: On this planet, flora and fauna evolved into a predatory eat-or-be-eaten scheme. They provide a lot of nutrients but will also actively hunt out other living creatures for sustenance.

entries.zh: 这颗行星充斥着老旧废弃的舰船和一座坠毁的轨道船坞。它是一处打捞珍贵金属和老旧科技的绝佳场所。
entries.en: This planet is filled with old derelict ships and a fallen orbital shipyard. It makes for a great place to scavenge for precious metals as well as old technology.

entries.zh: 这颗行星的一个半球被邻近的脉冲星侵蚀，使这一面成为了无法居住的废土，但却能使我们与能量相关科技的研究设施以极高效率运作。
entries.en: Half of the planet is battered by a nearby pulsar star. It turned this surface into an inhabitable wasteland, but it allows our research facilities to work on energy-related tech in a vastly accelerated manner.
